profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Mercedes-Benz Research & Development North America, Inc.
profile.summary: Generalist programmer with over 20 years of experience with wildly different backgrounds ranging from game development and tools programming to full stack development to embedded development. Passionate about tools for accessibility to productivity multipliers. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's degree focused in computer sceience from Full Sail University. Principals I live by: Get shit done and get it done fast.

company.name: Mercedes-Benz Research & Development North America, Inc.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Voice AI, Full stack, miscellaneous topics.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Framework developer for headunit platform (HMI, service framework, and tooling)
* Speech platform development and integration

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer and Designer
positions.description:
2nd Saturday events (80s and 90s themed events)
- Designed ads for the Metro newspaper
- Designed 4x6 flyers for the promoters to hand out
- Designed Red Carpet event style backdrop for photo shoots
Miscellaneous print media
- Poster and flyers for 2013 New Year Event
- 6x4 Menu inserts (Daily Drink Specials for Pearl Lounge)
Maintaining pearlriverchinese.com
- Progressively integrating content
- Added a gallery section using php Facebook API to access the gallery feed from the albums of the Facebook pages
- Redesigned the home page to use a jquery slider control to push updates and promote events

Skillset: PHP, Javascript, JQuery, HTML, CSS, Photoshop

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Integrating against middleware and backend systems
- Primarily used MVVM pattern as a bridge for the backend systems
UI/UX developer
- Created custom controls
- Animations and transitions for control states and page transitions
Designed, developed, and maintained API across four internal projects
Documentation and tech support for marketing
UI/UX experience with 10’ UI and touch devices
Worked side-by-side with a designer implementing features
- Implemented UI from a mockup
- Prototyped new controls with Expression Blend
- Prototyped app flow with Balsamiq
Developed custom EPG control
- Support for touch enabled devices
- Support for remote control
Developed services to automate long processes
- Automated connecting with the tribune servers, downloading EPG payload, decompressing the data, parsing the xml files, and inserting the channel listing into the database
- DVR services: scheduling, canceling, recording, and resolving conflicts
Filed pending software patent (co-author) Free Space Scroller for Electronic Programming Guide.

Skillset: .NET, C#, WPF, TortoiseSVN, Visual Studio 2010, Expression Blend, and Photoshop

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Porting tools to Qt
Credited for God of War: Chains of Olympus
Tools creation
- Asset viewer
- Animation tree blender
Tools maintenance
- Improving workflow
- Stabilization
- Feature implementation
AI scripting for several enemy characters
- Hyperion Guard
- Morpheus Beast
- Minotaur
Later abandoned Qt for WPF to create a PropertyGrid style control for the new engine pipeline
- Flexible UI where all of the properties can be reordered, added, and deleted
- Docking & Undocking
- Persistent states
- Z-Brush style hotkey system

Skillset : C++, C#, Maya, Photoshop, Visual Studio 2008, Perforce, Maya API , .NET, and WPF

certifications.title: Software Architecture: From Developer to Architect

projects.title: #HeyMercedes + ChatGPT
projects.description: First OEM to integrate ChatGPT into their in-car voice assistant.

projects.title: Majel (Discord Bot)
projects.description: This is a discord bot for the Star Trek Adventures roleplaying community. Its purpose is to help the players and game master perform operations described in the game's rules such as rolling dice and maintaining game states.

patents.title: Free space scroller for electronic programming guide
patents.description: A computing device displays an electronic programming guide. The computing device receives a multi-axis scrolling command. In response to the command, the device scrolls the EPG along both a time axis and a channel axis based on the multi-axis scrolling command.

patents.title: Method and System to Personalize User Experience in a Vehicle
